import html # HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ User Content

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_text: str) -> str: """ Create an HTML response by safely inserting user-provided content into the predefined template. Parameters: input_text (str): The raw text supplied by the user. Returns: str: An HTML string with the escaped user content embedded. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS or injection attacks safe_content = html.escape(input_text, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
